question: Should Discord orphan-session cleanup be automatic, operator-previewed, or agent-invoked, and what reachability, retention, and permission policy should govern deletion?
rationale: Current behavior intentionally preserves durable channel/thread session rows, while every proposed fix path can delete persisted session state based on external Discord reachability or a new permission surface.

options.title: Preview and revalidate before deletion
options.body: Add plugin-owned Discord orphan detection with an operator/admin preview and immediate revalidation before deleting session rows or archiving transcripts.

options.title: Expose a scoped delete/GC tool
options.body: Add an explicitly permissioned sessions_delete or sessions_gc surface after defining which agents may delete rows and what transcript retention guarantees apply.

options.title: Keep reset-only for now
options.body: Preserve archived-thread reset semantics and defer destructive cleanup to the broader session-prune product decision.

recommendation.title: Preview and revalidate before deletion
recommendation.body: Add plugin-owned Discord orphan detection with an operator/admin preview and immediate revalidation before deleting session rows or archiving transcripts.

likelyOwner.reason: Session maintenance preservation and recent session-control history make this the strongest available routing owner for the product policy choice.
